title: NACIE Improvement Act
official_summary:
National Advisory Council on Indian Education Improvement Act or the NACIE Improvement Act

This act requires the President to ensure that the National Advisory Council on Indian Education includes at least one member who is the president of a tribal college or university.

summary.headline: New law requires a national advisory council on Native education to include at least one tribal college or university president.
summary.what_it_does: The National Advisory Council on Indian Education gives advice on education programs for American Indian and Alaska Native students. This law requires the President to make sure at least one member of that council is the president of a tribal college or university.

who_it_affects.group: Presidents of tribal colleges and universities
who_it_affects.how: At least one of them must be appointed to the National Advisory Council on Indian Education.
Must include a tribal college or university president when choosing members of the council.

who_it_affects.group: American Indian and Alaska Native students and their communities
who_it_affects.how: The council that advises on their education programs will include a voice from tribal higher education.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 23, 2024; the summary does not give a separate start date.
